title: Paras Healthcare Limited Strengthens Cancer Care in Jharkhand with State-of-the-Art Radiation Facility at Ranchi Unit
summary: Paras Healthcare has expanded cancer services in Jharkhand by commissioning a modern radiation oncology facility at its Ranchi unit. The new center adds advanced radiotherapy technology, multidisciplinary oncology services and supportive care, aiming to reduce patient travel, shorten wait times and improve local access to comprehensive cancer treatment across the region.
content:
Paras Healthcare Limited has announced the opening of a state-of-the-art radiation oncology facility at its Ranchi unit, a move intended to bolster cancer care services across Jharkhand and neighbouring areas.

The newly commissioned centre is reported to include modern radiotherapy infrastructure, such as an advanced linear accelerator with image-guided and intensity-modulated radiotherapy capabilities, a dedicated CT simulator for precise treatment planning and an integrated treatment planning system. Ancillary services include outpatient oncology clinics, chemotherapy support, and patient counselling areas to provide comprehensive, multidisciplinary care.

Hospital officials emphasise that the facility will improve access to timely radiation therapy for patients who previously had to travel long distances to other cities. By bringing advanced radiotherapy technology and a coordinated oncology team to Ranchi, the unit aims to reduce treatment delays and financial and logistical burdens for patients and families across the state.

The clinical model is built around a multidisciplinary tumour board that brings together medical, radiation and surgical oncologists, along with specialised nursing staff, physiotherapists and palliative care providers. This approach is intended to ensure individualized treatment plans and continuity of care from diagnosis through follow-up.

Beyond direct treatment services, the unit is expected to support early detection and community outreach initiatives. Plans include awareness drives, screening camps and partnerships with local healthcare providers to strengthen referral pathways and encourage earlier presentation of cancer symptoms.

The expansion is also likely to have institutional benefits, including training opportunities for oncology staff and technicians and potential reductions in referral pressure on tertiary centres outside the state. By situating advanced cancer care within Ranchi, Paras Healthcare aims to decentralise access and contribute to improving cancer outcomes in the region.

While specific operational details and patient capacity figures were not disclosed at the time of the announcement, the addition of this radiation facility marks a meaningful step toward more comprehensive oncology services in Jharkhand and represents part of a wider trend of private hospital investment in regional cancer care.
